title: Fulfillment: stay in Oakland or move to Reno
variant: Plain printed memo: ruled header block, bottom line in a box
prompt: Brief me on whether we should move our fulfillment warehouse from Oakland to Reno; we ship 900 orders a day.
note: The plainest memo of the three on purpose: a white sheet on a gray ground, a ruled To, From, Date, Re block, the bottom line in a heavy black box, numbered serif headings, and a narrow measure, so it reads like the printed staff memo the reader already knows how to skim. The three options are parallel cards with identical Cost, Risk, and Forecloses fields so the reader compares line for line, and only the recommended card carries a brand border.
